The '''ISB Academy and Offices''',<ref name="LD" /> simply known as '''ISB Academy''',<ref name="What a Festive Evening">{{Andor|What a Festive Evening}}</ref> was a building located in the [[Verity District]] on the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[capital]] [[planet]] of [[Coruscant]]. The Academy was a school in which the [[Galactic Empire]]'s [[Imperial Security Bureau]] trained its personnel.<ref name="LD" />
